title: 第3章 融入日常-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》
content:
第(1/3)页

    日子就这么一天天过去了。

    王建新慢慢摸清了草原上的规矩。早上天不亮起来挤奶，烧茶，吃奶干。然后赶着羊群出去，走到草场上待一天，太阳快落山的时候回来。晚上又是手把肉或者面条，吃完学一会儿蒙语，然后睡觉。

    一天两顿，顿顿差不多。

    没有菜，没有水果，没有零食。想吃口甜的，就只能嚼奶干，嚼出那一点点甜味。

    头一个星期最难熬。肚子老是饿，嘴老是馋，脑子里老是想着北京街头的大包子、炸酱面、糖火烧。想得多了，嘴里就冒酸水。

    但王建新没吭声。他知道吭声没用，还不如省点力气干活。

    骑马倒是进步了不少。从最开始的趴马背上不敢动，到能坐直了，到能小跑一段，到能单手抓着缰绳赶羊——也就用了十来天。苏和说他学得快，王建新自己知道，这是32岁灵魂的耐心在起作用。上辈子当厨子，站灶台前一站就是一天，最不缺的就是耐性。

    放羊也摸到点门道了。羊群看着乱哄哄的，其实有规矩。头羊往哪儿走，后面的跟着。只要盯住头羊，其他的就不用太操心。草场上哪儿草好，哪儿有水，羊自己也知道，但它们不会规划路线，走哪儿算哪儿，得人帮着往好草场赶。

    王建新每天跟着苏和出去，眼睛不闲着，耳朵也不闲着。

    “这片草场的碱度大，羊吃多了拉稀。”

    “那边洼地春天有积水，羊不能喝，喝了胀气。”

    “看见那个石头堆了吗？那是敖包，绕着走，别从中间穿过去。”

    苏和教得随意，想到哪儿说到哪儿。王建新全记在心里。

    他现在已经能用简单的蒙语跟苏和说话了。“赛努”是你好，“巴雅尔拉”是谢谢，“塔”是您。苏和说他学蒙语也快，王建新觉得可能是因为自己脑子比以前好使了点——不知道是穿越的后遗症，还是修炼功法起了作用。

    说到功法，还是老样子。

    每天晚上等苏和睡着，王建新就溜到蒙古包后面，进空间里练一会儿。盘腿坐着，调呼吸，意守丹田，感受灵气。

    啥也没有。

    坐了十天了，屁都没感受到。

    有时候王建新都怀疑这功法是不是假的，但脑子里那篇文字清清楚楚，不像是骗人的。可能是他资质不行？或者是因为心静不下来？

    空间里倒是有点变化。

    那条小河里的鱼，倒是经常能看到，都是巴掌大的，黑乎乎的，不知道什么品种。王建新琢磨着能不能捞几条上来养，又怕给养死了。

    土地还是空着。他试着从外面带了一捧土进来，跟空间的土比较了一下。外面草原上的土发黄发干，空间的土是黑褐色的，攥在手里油润润的，明显肥得多。

    “这要是种上土豆，怕是能长到人头那么大。”王建新每次进来都要念叨一遍。

    可种子呢？

    他问过苏和，生产队种不种地。苏和说不种，牧民不种地，吃粮食靠国家供应，面粉每个月按人头发。菜就更不用想了，一年到头见不着几回。

    王建新又问，那知青们想种菜怎么办？苏和说，知青点后面开了巴掌大一块地，种了点萝卜，去年秋天收了二十来斤，没几天就吃完了。

    二十来斤萝卜，十几个人吃几天。

    王建新听完，彻底断了从生产队搞种子的念头。

    得另想办法。

    这天下午，王建新正在草场上放羊，远远看见一个人骑马过来。

    等走近了，认出来了——是张爱国。

    “建新！”张爱国跳下马，脸晒得黑红黑红的，嘴唇干裂了，起了皮，“可找着你了。”

    “怎么了？”

    “李红梅病了。”张爱国说，“拉了两天肚子，今天早上开始发烧，人都迷糊了。我们去叫了公社的卫生员，卫生员说可能是急性痢疾，他那儿没药，让送旗里医院。”

    “那送了吗？”

    “没车。”张爱国急得直搓手，“生产队就一辆马车，昨天去拉粮了，明天才能回来。我们几个知青商量着骑马送她去，但她那个样子骑不了马。大家说让我来找你，问你有没有办法或有没有带药。”

    王建新皱了皱眉。

    急性痢疾，拖久了会出人命。

    “带我去看看。”

    他把羊群交给苏和，跟张爱国骑马往回赶。

    知青点门口围了一圈人。王建新掀开门帘进去，看见李红梅躺在炕上，脸色蜡黄，嘴唇发白，额头上一摸——烫手。

    他蹲下来，搭上李红梅的手腕。

    这一搭，脑子里的东西就自动涌出来了。

    脉象细数，舌苔黄腻，腹痛里急后重，便下赤白脓血——确实是湿热痢，疫毒内蕴。按照宗师医术的判断，这是急性细菌性痢疾，已经出现了轻度脱水和电解质紊乱的迹象。

    “有药吗？”王建新问。

    “没有。”张爱国说，“卫生员那儿只有红药水紫药水，还有去痛片。”

    王建新沉默了几秒。

    他脑子里有几十个治痢疾的方子。白头翁汤、芍药汤、葛根芩连汤……方方都有效。问题是没有药。这个年代，公社卫生所连黄连素都缺，更别说中药了。

    “有没有陈茶叶？”王建新突然问。

    “啥？”张爱国没听清。

    “陈茶叶，就是放了好几年的那种。越陈越好。”

    “我那儿有。”一个女知青说，“我妈给我带的，我一直没舍得喝。”

    “拿来。”

    女知青跑回去拿了一包茶叶。王建新打开看了看，是普通的茉莉花茶，放了至少一两年了，颜色发暗，香味也没了。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The days passed like this.

Wang Jianxin slowly figured out the rules on the grassland.In the morning, I get up before dawn to express milk, make tea, and eat dried milk.Then he drove the sheep out, walked to the pasture and stayed there for a day, and came back when the sun was about to set.In the evening, we eat meat or noodles again, learn Mongolian for a while, and then go to bed.

​​Two meals a day, almost the same.

No vegetables, no fruits, no snacks.If you want to eat something sweet, you can only chew dried milk to bring out the little bit of sweetness.

The first week is the hardest.My stomach is always hungry, my mouth is always greedy, and my mind is always thinking about the big steamed buns, noodles with soybean paste, and sugar-fired food on the streets of Beijing.Thinking too much makes your mouth sour.

But Wang Jianxin remained silent.He knew it was useless to say anything, so he might as well save his energy and work.

Horse riding has improved a lot.It only took about ten days to go from lying on the horse without daring to move, to being able to sit up straight, to being able to trot for a while, to being able to hold the reins with one hand and drive the sheep.Su He said that he learned quickly, and Wang Jianxin himself knew that this was the patience of a 32-year-old soul at work.When I was a cook in my previous life, I spent a whole day standing in front of the stove. The most important thing I needed was patience.

I have learned a bit about herding sheep.The sheep may seem chaotic, but they actually have rules.Wherever the leader goes, the others follow.As long as you keep an eye on the leader, you don't have to worry too much about the rest.The sheep themselves know where the grass is best and where there is water, but they don't know how to plan their routes, so they need help driving them to good pastures.

Wang Jianxin goes out with Su He every day, his eyes and ears are not idle.

"The alkalinity of this pasture is high, and the sheep will have diarrhea if they eat too much."

"There is stagnant water in the depression over there in the spring. The sheep cannot drink it and will become bloated after drinking it."

"Did you see that pile of stones? That's Aobao. Walk around it, don't go through the middle."

Su He taught in a casual manner and talked about whatever came to mind.Wang Jianxin kept it all in mind.

He can now speak to Su He in simple Mongolian."Sainu" means hello, "Bayalla" means thank you, and "Ta" means you.Su He said that he learned Mongolian quickly. Wang Jianxin thought it might be because his brain worked better than before - he didn't know whether it was the sequelae of time travel or the practice of exercises.

When it comes to skills, it’s still the same.

Every night when Su He fell asleep, Wang Jianxin would sneak behind the yurt and practice in the space for a while.Sit cross-legged, regulate your breathing, focus on your Dantian, and feel the spiritual energy.

Nothing.

I’ve been sitting there for ten days and I haven’t even felt a fart.

Sometimes Wang Jianxin doubts whether this exercise is fake, but the text in his mind is clear and does not look like a lie.Maybe it's because he's not qualified?Or is it because you can’t calm down?

There are some changes in the space.

The fish in that small river can often be seen. They are all palm-sized, black, and I don’t know what species they are.Wang Jianxin wondered if he could catch a few fish and raise them, but he was afraid that they would be raised to death.

The land is still empty.He tried bringing in a handful of soil from outside and compared it with the soil in space.The soil on the grassland outside is yellow and dry, while the soil in the space is dark brown, oily and moist in the hand, and obviously much fatter.

"If we plant potatoes here, I'm afraid they can grow as big as a human head." Wang Jianxin would repeat it every time he came in.

​ But what about the seeds?

He asked Su He if the production team would farm.Su He said that the herdsmen did not cultivate the land and relied on the state to provide food. Flour was worth a hair per person every month.There is no need to think about the dishes, which are rarely seen throughout the year.

Wang Jianxin asked again, what should the educated youth do if they want to grow vegetables?Su He said that they opened a palm-sized piece of land behind the Educated Youth Point and planted some radishes. They harvested about 20 kilograms last fall and finished them in a few days.

Twenty kilograms of radishes can be eaten by a dozen people for several days.

After Wang Jianxin heard this, he completely gave up the idea of ​​producing seeds from the production team.

You have to find another way.

That afternoon, Wang Jianxin was tending sheep on the pasture when he saw a man riding a horse from a distance.

When I got closer, I recognized him - it was Zhang Aiguo.

"Jianxin!" Zhang Aiguo jumped off the horse, his face was sunburned and red, his lips were chapped and peeled, "I've found you."

"What's wrong?"

"Li Hongmei is sick," Zhang Aiguo said. "I had diarrhea for two days and started to have a fever this morning. I was all confused. We called the commune health worker. The health worker said it might be acute dysentery. There was no medicine there, so we sent her to Qili Hospital."

"Did you send it as a gift?"

"There is no car." Zhang Aiguo rubbed his hands in a hurry. "The production team only has a carriage. They went to collect food yesterday and will not come back until tomorrow. A few of us educated youths discussed riding a horse to send her there, but she was in such a state that she couldn't ride a horse. Everyone said that I should come to you and ask you if there is anything you can do or if you have brought any medicine."

Wang Jianxin frowned.

Acute dysentery can kill people if it lasts for a long time.

"Take me to see it."

He handed the sheep to Su He and rode back with Zhang Aiguo.

A circle of people gathered at the entrance of the Educated Youth Point.Wang Jianxin opened the door curtain and went in. He saw Li Hongmei lying on the kang, her face was sallow, her lips were white, and her forehead was hot to the touch.

He squatted down and put his hand on Li Hongmei's wrist.

With this combination, things in my mind automatically flowed out.

Thready and rapid pulse, yellow and greasy tongue coating, abdominal pain with severe tenesmus, and red and white pus and blood in the stool - it is indeed damp-heat dysentery, containing epidemic toxins.According to the master's medical judgment, this was acute bacillary dysentery, with signs of mild dehydration and electrolyte imbalance.

"Is there any medicine?" Wang Jianxin asked.

"No." Zhang Aiguo said, "The hygienist only has red liquid, purple liquid, and painkillers."

Wang Jianxin was silent for a few seconds.

He has dozens of remedies for dysentery in his mind.Pulsatilla decoction, peony decoction, Pueraria lobata and Qinlian decoction...all the prescriptions are effective.The problem is there is no medicine.In this era, commune health centers lack even berberine, let alone traditional Chinese medicine.

"Are there any old tea leaves?" Wang Jianxin asked suddenly.

"What?" Zhang Aiguo didn't hear clearly.

"Old tea is the kind that has been stored for several years. The older the tea, the better."

"I have it over there." A female educated youth said, "My mother brought it to me, but I have never been willing to drink it."

"Bring it here."

The female educated youth ran back and got a bag of tea.Wang Jianxin opened it and took a look. It was ordinary jasmine tea. It had been stored for at least a year or two. The color had darkened and the fragrance had disappeared.
Page (1/3)
title_en: Chapter 3 Integrating into daily life - "In the beginning of the 1970s, I made a fortune from zero-yuan purchases"
